testsuite.name: UC14 Alert Users by Email
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: There is an active authenticated session.

step.actions: user: The user has successfully changed his/her password (UC11, S1/S2). An email informing the user of the password change is sent to the user including the MID but not the password.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: The status of an appointment
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 1: The status of an appointment
testcase.preconditions: There is an active authenticated session.

step.actions: hcp: The status of an appointment request has been changed by the HCP involved in the request (UC6, S3). An email informing the patient of their appointment status is sent.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: Account has been locked out
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 2: Account has been locked out
testcase.preconditions: There is an active authenticated session.

step.actions: user: A user account has been locked out, either temporarily or permanently, due to too many failed logins. An email informing the user of their lockout is sent.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
